sentences.en: My breakfast cereal was crunchy until I added the milk.
sentences.zh: 我加了牛奶后燕麦才变得脆口。

sentences.en: I can't start the day without my morning cereal.
sentences.zh: 不吃早餐燕麦我就无法开始新的一天。

sentences.en: I got this spoon from a cereal box as a kid.
sentences.zh: 小时候我从一盒燕麦中得到了这个勺子。

senses.zh: 谷类，谷物；谷类食品；谷类植物
